utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Bank holiday or not, here we are. Can you all hear me?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, unfortunately. Had all these weekend plans, barbecue, bit of gardening. Weather had other ideas.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: You didn't actually get the barbecue out?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Got as far as taking the cover off. Put it straight back on. Very productive weekend.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Meanwhile the heating in the portakabin thinks it's December. I'm sitting here with the door open.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: So that's where all the heat's going. Certainly isn't reaching my end.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Morning—sorry, Teams picked the wrong microphone again. Am I coming through now?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, you're fine now. Bit echoey, but fine.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Better than mine. I've got about three people coming out of one little speaker.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Aisha Begum and Jamie Brennan aren't with us today. We've got everyone else, so let's crack on.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, I'm here. Calendar's open, coffee's mostly working.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: First, I'm not sending that shift handover report round after all. The other shift already sorted it, so there's no point duplicating it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Fair enough. One copy's plenty.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And, um, the new starters' training records—I've got the first half done. There's a fair bit left in the second half.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, those folders are thicker than they look.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: My contractor booking for the Arburg is stuck. Waiting on the permit to be signed; I can't get any further with it until that's through.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That's the hold-up, then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The near-miss write-up for the Arburg is finished, though. All signed off.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Ah, good. Cheers.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And that monthly fire alarm test we had sitting without an owner—I'll take it on. Put Mide against that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, that's agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Doyler asked me to pass on that the risk assessment update for work on the Injection Moulding Line 2 needs to move off her list. Reidy, can you take that over?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take over the risk assessment update.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Cheers, appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Oh, and I tested the turbine one gas valve yesterday. It's all fine now, that's sorted.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Good news. Nice to hear something behaved itself.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, onto the new bits. What have we got?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the stacker next week. Normal priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tomasz Nowak. Guarding check on the stacker, next week, normal priority. Agreed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep. Nothing more urgent than that being suggested.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's sensible.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz Nowak, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team first thing tomorrow as well?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take organising that on. I haven't got the capacity for it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Doyler, can you take that instead—organise the toolbox talk for the team, first thing tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll organise it. First thing tomorrow, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. That's with you, then.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Always nice getting the one where everyone looks thrilled to be there.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's just my face before breakfast, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you swap the filter on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit by end of day? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, so that's an immediate start, not something to leave until the end of the shift?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Straight away, with the filter swapped by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. I'll swap the filter on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit. Straight away, done by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, safety critical takes it out of the ordinary queue.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Absolutely. No argument from me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Tommo, can you go to the treatment plant to pick up the replacement parts for the main water valve by the 28th? That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just checking—you're asking me to collect the parts, not fit them as part of this?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct, collection of the replacement parts. Treat it as safety critical straight away; the collection deadline is by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll go to the treatment plant and pick up the replacement parts for the main water valve by the 28th. Safety critical, straight away—got it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Three versions of your name this morning. Teams will think we've got a bigger maintenance department.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same bloke, sadly. Same pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. Everyone clear on what's been agreed?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, clear from me.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: All clear here too.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. And the sun's come out now we're all indoors. Typical.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Of course it has. Right, thanks everyone. That's us.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
